about: Proposed engines for data/surfaces/engines.json, from the universe dump of 2026-10-03 after a verifier pass. Not loaded by engine.py. Each entry is an engines.json entry plus three review keys (proposed_from, installed, blocked_by) that engine.py's check_spec refuses as unknown, so strip those three when an entry is merged. Ranking and the surface ideas that cannot be a spec are in docs/ENGINE-CANDIDATES.md.

engines.title: Anarlog meetings
engines.install: brew install --cask anarlog, then Settings > Developers > Install CLI
engines.blocked_by: Not installed: no anarlog binary at either detect path and no Anarlog.app. Whether the cask puts the CLI on PATH is unverified, and the CLI's install location (Settings > Developers > Install) is unconfirmed, so the detect paths are a guess. Row keys title and created_at are unconfirmed: only id and folder_path are pinned by output.rs, so read real output before merging. Repo is in data/oss-apps/apps.json as MIT, remixable.

engines.title: Drive recent files
engines.install: brew install googleworkspace-cli, then gws auth setup
engines.blocked_by: Not in data/oss-apps/apps.json, so engine.py refuses it until it is added as Apache-2.0 and remixable. Also not installed (no gws at either detect path), and needs gws auth setup plus a one-time OAuth approval in a browser before the read returns anything. An npm global install lands under the nvm prefix, which is not a detect path.
